balanced_local.description: Checkpoint subset to keep on local disk after exact HF archival is complete.

conservative_archive.description: Checkpoint superset worth exporting to HF for long-term recovery and curve reconstruction.

selection_bucket_definitions.used_elsewhere: Checkpoint is referenced by downstream eval, row-recompute, or materialized-export workflows.
selection_bucket_definitions.best_eval_acc: Checkpoint is the best recorded validation/test accuracy or sits on the best late-stage accuracy plateau.
selection_bucket_definitions.best_eval_loss_or_proxy: Checkpoint is the best eval-loss candidate when comparable loss exists; otherwise use a proxy such as lowest avg_completion_tokens or a first-major-jump checkpoint.
selection_bucket_definitions.last: Final saved checkpoint for the run or the final exported/HF-backed checkpoint.
selection_bucket_definitions.extras: Conservative archive-only checkpoint kept for curve reconstruction, explicit historical tests, or sparse instrumentation.

selection_basis: cover the core buckets used_elsewhere, best_eval_acc, best_eval_loss_or_proxy, and last whenever local evidence exists
use a proxy metric or explicit transition checkpoint when comparable eval_loss is not recorded for the run
treat additional curve anchors or historically tested checkpoints as conservative archive-only extras
